<table style="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;border-spacing:0;width:100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;1.01.</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;12, 2026, Silver Point Private Credit Fund (the &#8220;Fund&#8221;) provided notice to U.S. Bancorp Fund Services, LLC (the &#8220;Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator&#8221;)</span> that the Fund will terminate the Master Servicing Agreement (the &#8220;Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement&#8221;) between the Fund and the Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> pursuant to its terms. Pursuant to the Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement, the Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> provides certain administrative and professional services to the Fund for which Silver Point Private Credit Fund Management, LLC (the &#8220;Adviser&#8221;) is primarily responsible under the investment advisory agreement between the Adviser and the Fund. The Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement will be terminated effective December&#160;31, 2026. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;12, 2026, the Fund entered into a <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrative</span> Services Agreement (the &#8220;New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement&#8221;) among the Fund, the Adviser and HS Financial Technologies Corporation (the &#8220;New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator&#8221;).</span> Under the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement, effective January&#160;1, 2027, the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> will provide certain administrative and professional services to the Fund, which are substantially similar to the services provided by the Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> under the Previous <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement, for which the Adviser is primarily responsible pursuant to the investment advisory agreement between the Fund and the Adviser. Pursuant to the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement, the Fund will pay the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> a monthly service fee. The New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement will have an initial term of <span style="white-space:nowrap">one-year</span> and will automatically renew for successive <span style="white-space:nowrap">one-year</span> periods thereafter. The New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement may be terminated by the Fund upon at least sixty days&#8217; notice to the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> or by the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administrator</span> upon at least 180 days&#8217; notice to the Fund. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The description above is only a summary of the material provisions of the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the provisions of the New <span style="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Administration</span> Agreement, a copy of which is attached hereto as Exhibit 10.1. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;1.02.</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The relevant information set forth in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> is incorporated herein by reference. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
